user.title: enerABot Setup
user.description: Select an energy meter sensor. The direction (import/export) is derived from the OBIS code (1.8.x = import, 2.8.x = export). Optionally enter the real meter reading to calibrate the offset immediately.

data.name: Meter Name
data.obis_code: OBIS Code (e.g. 1.8.2 for import, 2.8.2 for export)

data_description.sensor: Only sensors with device class 'energy' are shown. If your meter sensor doesn't appear, check that the correct device class is set.
data_description.price_sensor: Only sensors with device class 'monetary' are shown. If your price sensor doesn't appear, check that the correct device class is set.

init.title: enerABot Meter Correction
init.description: Enter the current real meter reading to calculate the offset.

data_description.price_sensor: Only sensors with device class 'monetary' are shown. If your price sensor doesn't appear, check that the correct device class is set.

set_energy_meter.name: Set energy meter
set_energy_meter.description: Set the energy meter value and calculate the offset.

meter_value.name: Meter Value
meter_value.description: The current real meter reading in kWh

reset_meter.name: Reset meter
reset_meter.description: Reset the stored offset, cost accumulator and correction history for a meter.

entity_id.name: Energy Sensor
entity_id.description: The energy sensor entity_id to reset

reset_all.name: Reset all meters
reset_all.description: If true, resets all configured enerABot meters instead of just one
